description: One series' value at the shared index of an index tooltip (ChartTooltipMode.Index): which series it is, its label, its value and its color, so a custom TooltipIndexTemplate can keep the legend's swatch.

members.name: DatasetIndex
members.description: Zero-based index of the series inside ChartData.Datasets.

members.name: Label
members.description: The series label (ChartDataset.Label), as the legend shows it.

members.name: Value
members.description: The series value at the index, in the data's own unit. It is formatted by the caller, so a template can choose its own format.

members.name: Color
members.description: The series color, so a custom template can keep the legend's swatch.

usageExample: @foreach (var series in ctx.Series) { @series.Label: @series.Value.ToString("N0") }
